reviews.review_msg: Avoid at all cost. Don't get me wrong, she's really passionate and knowledgeable. She LOVES her research, and she puts in a lot of effort in the lecture slides. She also makes sure your questions get answered. However, covering a WHOLE TEXTBOOK 400pg in 13 weeks is not what the students deserved. 2 midterms,1final,5 in-class writing assignment.
